definitions.supplemental: Cf. Icel. há-flæðr a high flood-tide.
definitions.meaning: High tide [as opposed to neap tide], deep water

quotations.english: he let a raven fly over the deep water [of the deluge]

source_text: heáh-flód, es; m. High tide [as opposed to neap tide], deep water :-- Heáhflód malina: népflód ledona, Ælfc. Gl. 105; Som. 78, 30, 29; Wrt. Voc. 37, 12, 11. Lét fleógan hrefn ofer heáhflód he let a raven fly over the deep water [of the deluge], Cd. 71; Th. 87, 1; Gen. 1442. [Cf. Icel. há-flæðr a high flood-tide.]
